evidence: Ngliyep (Kec. Donomulyo) described with soft sand and calm atmosphere where visitors can swim; caveat: Bajulmati has big waves and no swimming - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/pantai-di-malang
Fine white sand, relatively calm sea; swimming in the calm safe area listed as an activity, 20-30 min from Sorong city centre - https://id.trip.com/guide/attraction/tempat-wisata-di-sorong.html
Suitability study rates the waters very suitable for swimming at 0-2 m depth (approx. 392 m swim zone); white sand shore per IPB journal - https://ejournal.bsi.ac.id/index.php/jp/article/view/2158

Travel guides list swimming and playing in sand with calm waves; caveat: academic sources describe sand mixed with mud and turbid water - https://www.goodnewsfromindonesia.id/network/content/5-destinasi-wisata-alam-terbaik-di-cirebon-untuk-liburan-keluarga-FWTAOU
2 km white-sand beach in Kec. Tanjungbumi with showers for swimmers and beach guards; caveat: abrasion - https://beritajatim.com/simponi-deru-ombak-dan-tawa-anak-di-pantai-tlangoh-bangkalan
Black-sand lagoon-like beach with small waves and clear water; non-swimmers advised to rent tubes, snorkeling popular; caveat: occasional high waves - https://www.hipwee.com/travel/ternate-tidore/
Black-sand beach in Kec. Suradadi, Kabupaten Tegal, with calm waves that make swimming possible - https://voinews.id/index.php/component/k2/item/2717-purwahamba-indah-beach

White-sand beach in Desa Labuhan, Kec. Brondong with small waves, suitable for children to swim; swimming a main activity - https://mongabay.co.id/2019/08/23/berkat-namanya-yang-unik-pantai-ini-justru-populer-di-lamongan/
White-sand beach in Distrik Depapre with gentle waves; visitors swim then rinse at nearby river mouth - https://www.merahputih.com/post/amp/pantai-amai-merasakan-air-tawar-bertemu-air-asin

Beach 3 km from Merauke with friendly waves; visitors can bathe in the sea calmly but should be able to swim; caveat: shoreline retreat, flat tidal sand - https://mamikos.com/info/pantai-dan-laut-pulau-papua-maluku-pljr/?halaman=3

Pasir Putih (5-6 km from Manokwari town) has clean fine white sand and relatively small waves allowing visitors to swim; Amban is a black-sand surf beach with no swim evidence - https://p2k.stekom.ac.id/ensiklopedia/Pantai_Pasir_Putih,_Manokwari

UNVERIFIED: Bambang is black sand but south-coast Lumajang beaches have high waves, drownings and no-bathing orders during high waves; no source confirming safe swimming - https://rri.co.id/jember/regional/2606230/wisatawan-pantai-di-lumjang-dilarang-mandi-karena-ombak-tinggi

Gently sloping black-sand beach 2 km east of Cilacap centre; activities include swimming and banana boat; caveat: sources differ on wave strength - https://www.viva.co.id/arsip/793254-mudik-ke-cilacap-intip-sembilan-wisata-alam-ini?page=all

UNVERIFIED: Lawata (Kec. Rasanae Barat, Kota Bima) has patrols and drowning-prevention SOP, but no source found describing sand type or sea swimming - https://www.detik.com/bali/nusra/d-7054525/10-wisata-pantai-di-pusat-kota-bima-cocok-untuk-healing-bareng-teman
Coro has soft white sand; guide says south Tulungagung beaches have big waves but are safe to swim (no coral), no lifeguards - https://www.orami.co.id/magazine/pantai-di-tulungagung
Brownish-white sand, gently sloping with calm waves making it safe to swim; caveat: moderately polluted per Trunojoyo study - https://ejurnal.its.ac.id/index.php/teknik/article/download/3114/843

Island off Probolinggo's north coast with white sand and clear water, snorkeling and water sports on the south side; Bentar has calm water but little sandy beach - https://www.detik.com/jatim/wisata/d-7315239/wisata-gili-ketapang-probolinggo-daya-tarik-lokasi-dan-tarifnya

Sloping sandy beach with calm waves; visitors swim freely, tubes rented by operator; caveat: rob flooding and abrasion - https://www.suara.com/purwokerto/2023/09/28/183357/berjarak-94-km-dari-stasiun-brebes-lokasi-ini-rekomended-untuk-wisata-keluarga

White-sand beach in Kec. Tonra, Kabupaten Bone; many visitors come to swim and rent boats (Tanjung Pallette not confirmed as sand beach) - https://rri.co.id/bone/ekonomi/umkm/1435660/libur-lebaran-penyewaan-perahu-di-pantai-tete-meningkat-tajam

Sandy beach in Kec. Banda Sakti; research lists swimming among visitor activities attracting tourists; caveat: abrasion and litter - https://usahid.ac.id/conference/index.php/snpk/article/download/20/17/16
